title: Office Furniture in Ottawa, Ontario
meta_description: New, commercial-grade office furniture for Ottawa government, tech, and healthcare offices, with the OECM path and Ontario-wide delivery and install.
author: Steve Katz
excerpt: A guide to buying new, commercial-grade office furniture in Ottawa: the city's government, Kanata technology, and healthcare sectors, what we supply for each, how Ontario-wide delivery and installation work for an Ottawa address, the OECM path that lets public institutions buy without a separate tender, and the honest new-versus-used picture.
faq_items: Do you deliver and install office furniture in Ottawa?||Yes. We deliver and install new commercial office furniture across Ontario, and Ottawa is within that service area, reached on the 416 and 417. Delivery is scheduled, workstations and panel systems are professionally installed on site rather than dropped curbside, and we coordinate the loading-dock, security-screening, and after-hours requirements that government and institutional buildings often add. We can also remove your old furniture as part of the job, with one point of contact for warranty and service after the install.

Can a federal or Ontario government office in Ottawa buy office furniture without a tender?||Eligible broader-public-sector organizations can. Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470, so eligible Ottawa school boards, colleges, universities, hospitals, and municipal offices can purchase eligible furniture through OECM without running a separate competitive process. Federal departments procure under their own federal framework, and we will confirm which path applies to your organization before anything is specified.

Do you furnish technology offices in Kanata?||Yes. Open technology floors are a core use case for us. We specify benching runs, height-adjustable desks, task seating, collaborative furniture, and training rooms, plan the layout to the floor plate and headcount, and install the whole project on a coordinated schedule. Mixing Canadian commercial lines to one budget is exactly what a multi-line dealer is built to do for a growing Kanata firm.

Do you sell used office furniture in Ottawa?||No. We sell new, commercial-grade furniture only. Ottawa has a large used and liquidation segment, fed in part by government turnover, but used pieces carry warranty and durability risk that often costs more over time. We focus on new product that is third-party tested, manufacturer-warranted, and built for a seven-to-ten-year life, and when budget is tight we phase the project or mix value lines rather than sell secondhand furniture.

Can you supply secure or fire-rated storage for records?||Yes. For departments and clinics that keep sensitive or critical paper, we specify lockable steel filing and fire-rated cabinets, including UL Class 350 one-hour-rated units that protect their contents in a fire. We match the storage to the records policy, the floor plan, and the security requirement rather than selling a generic cabinet.

How long does office furniture delivery take in Ottawa?||Made-to-order commercial finishes typically run about four to six weeks, and Canadian quick-ship options are available on common task chairs and casegoods when a move or a fiscal-year deadline cannot wait. We confirm lead times up front and coordinate a single install date rather than leaving you guessing, so an Ottawa office can plan its opening or its year-end purchase with confidence.
